full_name: Allegra Goodman | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Allegra Goodman is the author of three novels: Intuition (Dial Press, 2006), Paradise Park (Dial Press, 2001), and Kaaterskill Falls (Dial Press, 1998), which was a finalist for the National Book Award.
